name: HYBA_Sovereign_MCP
description: Top-level sovereign MCP manifest for HYBA / EUCLID / PhiEnterprise. Provides server registration for sovereign tools and exact mathematical kernels. Narrow AI does not receive credit, authority, or decision rights.

servers.name: hyba-mcp
servers.deployment_guidance: Primary server; qualify behind AL HARAS before deployment. See docs/MCP_DEPLOYMENT.md. scale_intelligence requires Intelligence.lucas_scaler and dependencies.
servers.description: Production HYBA MCP server — exact-math, repository-context, and governed expert-skill tools; qualify the host deployment before production use.

servers.name: exact-kernel
servers.deployment_guidance: Optional standalone surface; omit from production registration unless separately qualified.
servers.description: Separate standalone exact-kernel server; not covered by the hyba-mcp protocol qualification

servers.name: cogito
servers.deployment_guidance: Production-qualified through initialize plus JSON problem adaptation; place behind AL HARAS before deployment. See docs/MCP_DEPLOYMENT.md.
servers.description: Production Cogito MCP server — 12 EUCLID/TOE capabilities with initialize and JSON problem adaptation.

connectors.name: notion
connectors.description: Optional Notion-based MCP connector for canonical pages / knowledge access. Configure `url` and auth via environment variables or MCP secrets.

notes: Internal registration catalog, not an authorization policy. Select only qualified servers; status metadata does not prevent launch. See docs/MCP_DEPLOYMENT.md and docs/MCP_SECURITY.md. Replace ${REPO_ROOT} with the absolute checkout path and configure the host working directory there. Keep credentials and HMAC keys out of this manifest.
